text:
alex: There's a spud on the couch. No note, just vibes.
maria: Is it a snack or a spy?
sam: If it steals my pen, it's going in HR.
nora: Naming proposal: 'Couch Spud' or 'Tater Totter'. Vote with emoji.
alex: :one: Couch Spud  :two: Tater Totter
maria: :one: Couch Spud. Also request tiny hat.
sam: :one: Couch Spud. I'll make a tiny hat prototype at lunch.
safety-bot: Reminder: decorative items must not block egress paths. Safety first.
nora: Safety noted. We'll keep Spud within the lounge perimeter.
alex: Plan: adopt as temporary mascot, craft hat, document care instructions in /fun-wiki.
maria: GIF incoming: <link_to_potato_nod.gif> caption: "When the sprint hits but morale holds."
sam: Bringing glue and felt. Capes optional but encouraged.
nora: I'll create a badge. Team photo with Spud at 4pm?
alex: (typo) meant alex: 4pm works for the mini-ceremony. Socks optional.
maria: Thread summary: spud adopted, hat in progress, safety approved. Closing unless the spud relocates. :tada:
